name: W Minneapolis–The Foshay
positioning: A downtown Minneapolis hotel in the historic Foshay Tower, with art deco design, an observation deck and a 27th-floor cocktail bar with 360-degree views
best_for: Architecture and history fans who want to stay inside a landmark art deco tower
Visitors to downtown stadiums, arenas and the convention center

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites feature art deco details, contemporary furnishings and innovative amenities.
The Living Room is a lobby bar with an Art Deco, modern-chic vibe, artisan cocktails, a live DJ and a dance floor.
The Living Room has multiple lounge spots and an indoor fire.
Suites have signature W beds, an in-suite mini fridge, a Mix Bar and Bliss spa products.
The hotel is near U.S. Bank Stadium, the Minneapolis Convention Center, Target Field and Target Center.
Nicollet Mall, downtown's shopping and entertainment hub, is one block from the hotel.
Local artists' paintings and artwork line the hotel's entrance, the Runway.
The FIT fitness center is open 24 hours a day and has Peloton bikes, free weights, machines and treadmills.
Pets are welcome, with custom W dog beds and dishes for use in the room.

highlights.text: The observation deck offers exhibits on the Foshay Tower's history and 360-degree city views.
The hotel is inspired by the landmark Foshay Tower and blends historic character with modern luxury.
Prohibition Bar on the 27th floor serves cocktails with 360-degree views of downtown Minneapolis.
The two-bedroom, two-bathroom Penthouse King Suite on the 26th floor has a dining room, a separate living room, a fireplace in one bedroom and a soaking tub in the main bathroom.
The hotel's classic art deco fixtures stand out in a city of glass buildings.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a tranquil atmosphere.
WhataHotel notes pricing is premium, typical of the luxury W Hotels brand.
